content.text: Add email alert functionality to the uptime-monitor.

I implemented the email alert functionality in the alerts.py module. Here's the code I added:

```python
import smtplib
from email.mime.text import MIMEText

def send_email_alert(subject, body):
    sender = 'alert@example.com'
    recipient = 'user@example.com'
    msg = MIMEText(body)
    msg['Subject'] = subject
    msg['From'] = sender
    msg['To'] = recipient

    with smtplib.SMTP('smtp.example.com', 587) as server:
        server.starttls()
        server.login(sender, 'password')
        server.sendmail(sender, recipient, msg.as_string())
```

I also updated the main.py to call `send_email_alert` when an outage is detected. Now it can send alerts directly to user emails. Finally, I committed my changes with the message 'Added email alert functionality.'
